name: ALION Radio Player
notes: Glass redesign (airy frosted look). New Global tab with 50 verified world stations. Seasonal backgrounds with light live animation, auto by date: Halloween (lantern glow, bats, mist), Thanksgiving (falling leaves, candles), Christmas (snow, twinkling tree lights, aurora), New Year's (fireworks, confetti). Add your own backgrounds (several images, each with optional snow/leaves/sparkle). Effects toggle in Backgrounds.
